channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Naked Trump Statue Unveiled at EU Parliament
item.description: A nude gold statue depicting Donald Trump, referred to as 'Orange Plague,' has been unveiled at the European Parliament. The statue's display was reported by CNN and USA Today. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Michigan GOP Senate Candidate Defies Trump on Canada Tariffs
item.description: Michigan Republican Senate candidate John James has broken with former President Donald Trump's stance on tariffs, stating that "Canada is not our enemy." This marks a divergence from Trump's protectionist trade policies. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Nobel Laureate Demands Venezuelan Election Transparency Amid Oil Deal
item.description: Venezuelan Nobel Peace Prize laureate Maria Ressa has called for transparency regarding oil revenues, stating the country is 'ready' for new elections. This demand follows a reported deal involving former Trump administration officials… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Burnham meets German Chancellor Merz in Berlin for security talks
item.description: Mayor of Greater Manchester, Andy Burnham, met with German Chancellor Olaf Scholz in Berlin for security discussions. The meeting's agenda included topics relevant to security. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Donald Trump Not Awarded Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: Donald Trump was not awarded the Nobel Peace Prize, an award he has reportedly long coveted. He had previously stated that "nobody deserves it more" than him. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Carney: Canadians Will Decide Future After Musk's Separatism Remark
item.description: Mark Carney stated that Canadians will decide their future following Elon Musk's comments advocating for Quebec separatism. Carney's remarks emphasize that the decision rests with the Canadian people. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump Promotes New Child Investment Accounts
item.description: Former U.S. President Donald Trump is encouraging parents to claim "Trump Accounts," described as child investment accounts, with a reported value of $1,000. Auto-enrollment for these accounts has begun, and eligibility details are being… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.description: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has reviewed tens of millions of voter records to identify suspected noncitizen registrations. This action has been compared to India's Systematic Voter-Education and Electoral Registration… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump to Honor Elon Musk and Jensen Huang with US Science Medals
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump is set to award Elon Musk and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang with the nation's top science and technology medals. The announcement comes as Trump disclosed trades in Nvidia stock, the company led by Huang. Huang… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US Senator Vance calls Indians 'indentured laborers'; India responds
item.description: US Senator JD Vance referred to Indian H-1B visa holders as 'indentured laborers,' alleging that IT companies exploit the system by hiring foreign workers over Americans. India issued a sharp response, urging Vance not to forget America's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Chhattisgarh Transfers 18 IPS Officers
item.description: In Chhattisgarh, 18 Indian Police Service (IPS) officers have been transferred, with officials from the 2021 to 2024 batches assigned new responsibilities. Ishu Agarwal is among those named in the transfers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Gaurav Yadav Appointed Punjab's Regular Director General of Police
item.description: Gaurav Yadav has been appointed the regular Director General of Police (DGP) of Punjab and has assumed charge. Following his appointment, Yadav stated that there is no place for gangsters in Punjab. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Vote Counting Underway for Bypolls in Tamil Nadu and Puducherry
item.description: Vote counting has commenced for by-elections held in Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. Specifically, counting is underway for the Dharapuram Assembly Constituency in Tamil Nadu and the Thatchanjavady Assembly Constituency in Puducherry. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: India Defends Satellite Policy After Elon Musk's 'Oligarch' Remark
item.description: The Indian government has stated that its policies and processes for satellite communication clearances are "non-discriminatory" and "fair." This statement comes after Elon Musk, founder of SpaceX, referred to the Indian government's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: South African Jurist Navi Pillay Awarded Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: Navi Pillay, a South African jurist of Indian origin, has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her significant contributions to international law and human rights. Her ancestors migrated from India to Durban. She is described as… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.description: The All India N.R. Congress (AINRC) secured a significant victory in the Thattanchavady constituency bypoll in Puducherry, retaining the bastion of N. Rangasamy. In Tamil Nadu, the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) maintained its lead in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: In recent by-elections, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has consolidated its gains in West Bengal, securing unassailable leads in Nandigram and Rejinagar. The party is also leading in Assam. In Tamil Nadu, the AIADMK is ahead in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: India slams US Senator's 'indentured servants' remark on H-1B workers
item.description: India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) strongly condemned remarks made by US Senator JD Vance, describing them as 'deeply offensive' and 'unwarranted'. The MEA stated that Indian professionals significantly contribute to the US economy… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 3.

item.description: Zack Polanski has stated his intention to run for leadership again and continue his pursuit of becoming a Member of Parliament (MP). However, coverage from multiple outlets suggests his political future is uncertain, with one report… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: In a significant administrative reshuffle in Jammu and Kashmir, 49 officers from the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Jammu and Kashmir Administrative Service (JKAS) have been transferred. The order for this major reshuffling was… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Mayoral Candidates Debate Local Issues and Spending
item.description: Mayoral candidates in North Bay, Ontario, and Mississauga engaged in debates focusing on local issues, including the outgoing mayor's spending controversy in North Bay. The debates saw candidates clashing over various topics relevant to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Republican Mike Rogers Urges End to Canada Trade Dispute
item.description: U.S. Representative Mike Rogers, a Republican from Michigan, has called for an end to the trade dispute with Canada, which involves tariffs. This stance reportedly marks a departure from former President Donald Trump's policies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Congress Leaders Criticize PM Modi's Silence on Manipur
item.description: Congress leaders Jairam Ramesh and Pawan Khera have criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi, using the phrase 'Kab tak chappan' which translates to 'How long will you hide?'. This remark is directed at the Prime Minister's perceived… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Republicans Highlight Crime, Court Stakes Ahead of Midterms
item.description: Ahead of the midterm elections, Republicans are emphasizing a "tough-on-crime" message and raising alarms about the potential long-term impact on the Supreme Court. The coverage suggests these issues are seen as significant stakes in the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Malaysia's Melaka State Election Set for November 14 Amid Shifting Alliances
item.description: Melaka, a state in Malaysia, will hold its state election on November 14, with nominations opening on October 26. The election involves nearly 700,000 voters. This comes as the Barisan Nasional (BN) coalition, led by Umno, is reportedly… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Pakistan, Turkiye to Deploy Forces in Saudi Arabia Amid Houthi Threats
item.description: Pakistan and Turkiye have agreed to provide military support to Saudi Arabia, reinforcing a collective defense agreement. Representatives from the three nations met to bolster regional security in response to threats from Houthi rebels… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 18 · Right 7.

item.title: Protesters removed from chaotic Trump rally in Texas
item.description: Protesters were ejected from a Donald Trump rally in San Antonio, Texas, leading to a chaotic scene. Police removed individuals from the event. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ohio Senate Race Tests Democratic Appeal to Working-Class Voters
item.description: The upcoming Ohio Senate race is being closely watched as a test of the Democratic Party's ability to regain support from working-class voters. The contest is seen as potentially pivotal for control of the U.S. Senate and is putting former… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: South Korea Recalls Ukraine Ambassador Amid Diplomatic Dispute
item.description: South Korea has recalled its ambassador from Ukraine following a diplomatic dispute. The recall is reportedly linked to disagreements over prisoners of war. Ukraine has stated it is open to dialogue with South Korea regarding the situation. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Probes Universities Over J-1 Visas Amid Student Rule Tightening
item.description: The U.S. is investigating nine universities concerning the J-1 exchange visitor visa program, as the Trump administration tightens student-related rules. Senator JD Vance alleged that universities were utilizing foreign researchers to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim met with Myanmar's military-backed leader Min Aung Hlaing in Malaysia to discuss migrant repatriation. The visit occurred amidst protests by activists concerned about Myanmar's potential full… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: CEC faces calls for impeachment and sacking
item.description: Yogendra Yadav has called for the impeachment of the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC). Revanth Reddy has called for the BJP to sack the CEC. The coverage does not specify the reasons for these calls. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar has alleged that a plot to trap him in a sting operation was initiated soon after he took office. He stated he possesses evidence identifying those behind this alleged attempt. These claims follow… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the 'Viksit Bharat Sankalp Sabha' at the Indira Gandhi Stadium, where he received a warm welcome. During the Seva Jyoti Programme, he affirmed "We Will Do It" and pledged for a 'Viksit Bharat'… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump proposes new presidential retreat at his golf club
item.description: Former U.S. President Donald Trump has proposed establishing a new presidential retreat, referred to as a "new Camp David," at one of his private golf clubs. Trump stated that the idea is "a great idea" and that he wants to turn his… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump Diverts European Aid to Latin America Amid Political Pressure
item.description: Amid political pressure, Donald Trump has reportedly diverted aid previously designated for Europe to Latin America instead. This action has drawn defiance from Democrats. Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump labels AI proponents 'enemies' of White House
item.description: Former President Donald Trump has declared that anyone using the term Artificial Intelligence (AI) is an 'enemy' of the White House, particularly if they do not support his preferred terminology. A member of a Super Intelligence task force… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A protest is planned in Bengaluru on Thursday concerning alleged deletions from electoral rolls. The protest, referred to as a 'People's Tribunal', will be attended by Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh, Sourav, and various youth organizations and… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
